opening.argument: The offer combines paid bitcoin-mining participation with account purchases and a binary recruitment structure: viewers are told that “your account rests on two pillars” and that accounts can branch to both sides. The payment model is tied directly to adding members, with eight new members positioned across the branches producing a claimed $200 cycle payment for each account. It also promotes substantial earnings, including a $3,500 profit example and monthly team bitcoin earnings valued at $2 million, while continuing provisions are described as lasting many years. Yet the described records do not verify mining operations or payout results; they only state that pooled participation will acquire hardware for mining facilities.
